Constructor sets REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependence.
mint compares block.timestamp with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide startingIndexBlock.
mint loops calling _mintAnElement for each requested token.
presaleMint loops calling _mintAnElement for each requested token.
mintReserve loops calling _mintAnElement for each reserved token.
_mintAnElement calls _safeMint, which invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient before returning.
